overview: The GLE 450e 4MATIC is the plug-in hybrid variant of the midsize GLE-Class SUV. Combines a 2.0L turbocharged inline-4 with a 134-hp electric motor and 23.3 kWh usable / 31.2 kWh gross battery for 381 hp combined system output. 49 mi EPA-estimated all-electric range. Standard AWD, 9-speed automatic, DC fast-charge capable to ~60 kW. Sources: https://www.mbusa.com/en/vehicles/model/gle/suv/gle450e4 ; https://www.edmunds.com/mercedes-benz/gle/2026/plug-in-hybrid/
